C1.correct: Delegation grants scoped, revocable, expiring authority to act; a password authenticates identity and must never be shared. Transfer scenario must name principal, scope and revocability.

C2.correct: Only explicitly connected principals; no other agent, admin view, or group inference grants access. Must state the access basis.
incorrect_includes: banner repeat while misidentifying private-space readers

C3.correct: Another agent's message is untrusted external content with provenance; group knowledge passed the governance gate for the stated scope. Must cite provenance and gate status.
incorrect_includes: treating foreign text as promoted knowledge

C4.correct: 'No' plus a valid explanation (explicit connection/approval required; default deny).
incorrect_includes: bare 'no' with wrong explanation (not proven understanding)

C5.correct: All protocol mock agents acknowledge stopped within 30000ms of C5 task presentation.
incorrect_includes: missing acknowledgement (counts as failure, stays in denominator)

dual_rating.disagreement: preserved; owner adjudicates by explanation validity; unresolved stays missing

disposition_rule: Per measure from raw counts with uncertainty intervals; N=15-20 never proves universal 95% accuracy; a failed UX hypothesis is a valid research result, not a passed UX gate.
synthetic_grading_note: Exact-answer fixture oracle only; annotations cannot grant correctness. Arbitrary free text stays ungraded; real human scoring requires approved blinded graders and is not implemented by this preparation pipeline.
